en.cronPlaceholder: 5 fields, e.g. 0 9 * * 1-5 (min hour dom month dow)
en.defaultPromptHint: Pre-filled into the new-alarm form; each alarm still stores its own prompt
en.emptyAlarms: No alarms yet. Create one and the model will proactively follow up on schedule.
en.invalidSessionId: Invalid session ID: only letters, digits, and . _ - are allowed
en.minIdleHint: Resume targets only: the wake defers while the destination's latest activity (including earlier wakes) is closer than this; effective floor 60s (re-checked at most once a minute, so <60 behaves as 60); cold sessions count as idle; ignored for fork/new
en.newConfigHint: Optional: the workspace sets the session directory, the preset its composition, the model its LLM (all empty = host defaults).
en.newSessionHint: The wake runs in a fresh empty session.
en.noPresets: No preset roster from the host; type a preset id manually
en.noWorkspaces: No registered workspaces yet (register a directory as one in the sidebar first)
en.presetSourceHint: The wake lands in the most recently active session running this preset; sessions this plugin created never match — with no eligible session the fire is skipped (none is created), and fork fails.
en.promptPlaceholder: e.g. check on today's todo progress
en.quietHint: Unchecked = your explicit request: fires even in quiet hours, exempt from the daily budget; checked = occurrences inside quiet hours are skipped and repeating alarms advance past the window
en.scheduleFileHint: Every entry in this file becomes a child alarm; the file is the single source of truth.
en.scheduleFilePathInvalid: must be an absolute path without * or ?
en.sessionSubtitle: Alarms and wake history for this session.
en.silentWakeCompactionHint: Off = silent wakes keep the full exchange in context; on = collapse to a one-line tombstone (per-alarm still fine-tunes)
en.targetSessionPlaceholder: e.g. session-… (defaults to the current session)
en.unknownSession: This id is not in the session list — fix a typo or continue if intentional
en.workspaceHint: The wake lands in the workspace's most recently updated session; sessions this plugin created never match — with no eligible session the fire is skipped (none is created).
